## Getting Started

### Logging In

#### First-Time Login

**Step 1: Open the Application**
1. Navigate to [URL - e.g., https://app.productname.com]
2. You'll see the login screen

**Step 2: Enter Your Credentials**
1. Enter your **email address** in the Email field
2. Enter your **password** in the Password field
3. (Optional) Check **"Remember me"** to stay logged in on this device

**Step 3: Click "Log In"**
- If your credentials are correct, you'll be taken to your dashboard
- If you see an error, see [Troubleshooting Login Issues](#troubleshooting-login-issues)

**First-Time Setup:**
When you log in for the first time, you'll be guided through a setup wizard:
1. **Welcome Screen:** Click "Get Started"
2. **Profile Setup:** Add your name and profile photo (optional)
3. **Tour:** Take a 2-minute product tour (recommended) or skip
4. **Create Your First Project:** Follow the prompts to create your first project

#### Returning User Login

1. Go to [URL]
2. Enter your email and password
3. Click "Log In"

> **💡 Tip:** Bookmark the login page for quick access!

#### Forgot Password?

1. Click **"Forgot Password?"** below the login form
2. Enter your email address
3. Click **"Send Reset Link"**
4. Check your email for a password reset link (check spam if not received)
5. Click the link and follow the prompts to create a new password

**Reset Link Valid For:** 24 hours

### Dashboard Overview

Once logged in, you'll land on your **Dashboard** - your home base in [Product Name].

#### Dashboard Layout

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  [Logo]  Navigation Menu            [Search] [Profile] │  ← Header
├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                                        │
│  Welcome back, [Your Name]!            [+ New Project] │  ← Page Title
│  ────────────────────────────────────────────────────  │
│                                                        │
│  [Active: 5]  [Overdue: 2]  [Completed: 12]           │  ← Quick Stats
│                                                        │
│  Recent Projects                          [View All]   │  ← Recent Activity
│  • Project A - Last updated 2 hours ago               │
│  • Project B - Last updated yesterday                 │
│                                                        │
│  Activity Feed                                         │  ← Activity Stream
│  • Sarah commented on "Design Review"                 │
│  • New task assigned to you                           │
│                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

#### Key Dashboard Elements

**1. Header (Top Bar)**
- **Logo:** Click to return to dashboard from anywhere
- **Navigation Menu:** Access main sections (Projects, Team, Reports, Settings)
- **Search:** Global search for projects, tasks, people
- **Profile:** Your avatar - click for account menu (Profile, Settings, Logout)

**2. Quick Stats Cards**
- **Active:** Number of projects currently in progress
- **Overdue:** Projects past their due date (⚠️ requires attention)
- **Completed:** Total completed projects
- Click any card to filter your project list

**3. Recent Projects**
- Shows your 5 most recently updated projects
- Click a project to open it
- Click **[View All]** to see all projects

**4. Activity Feed**
- Recent updates from your team
- Comments, task assignments, status changes
- Click an activity to jump to that item

> **💡 Pro Tip:** Customize your dashboard in Settings > Dashboard Preferences to show the widgets you use most!

## Basic Features

### Feature 1: [Creating and Managing Projects]

#### What Is a Project?

A **project** in [Product Name] is [definition - e.g., "a workspace where you organize tasks, collaborate with your team, and track progress toward a goal"].

**Projects can include:**
- Tasks and subtasks
- Team members and roles
- Files and documents
- Comments and discussions
- Due dates and milestones

---

#### Creating a New Project

**Method 1: From Dashboard**

1. Click the **[+ New Project]** button (top right of dashboard)
2. The "Create Project" modal will appear

3. **Fill in project details:**
   - **Project Name:** (Required) Give your project a clear, descriptive name
     - ✅ Good: "Q1 Marketing Campaign"
     - ❌ Avoid: "Project 1"
   
   - **Description:** (Optional but recommended) Briefly describe what this project is about
     - Example: "Plan and execute our Q1 social media and content marketing campaigns"
   
   - **Due Date:** (Optional) When should this project be completed?
     - Click the calendar icon to select a date
   
   - **Project Type:** (Optional) Select from dropdown
     - Options: Marketing, Development, Design, Operations, Other

4. Click **[Create Project]**

5. **You're done!** Your project is created and you'll be taken to the project page

**Method 2: From Projects Page**

1. Go to **Projects** in the main navigation
2. Click **[+ Create Project]** in the top right
3. Follow steps 3-5 above

**Method 3: Quick Create (Keyboard Shortcut)**

- Press `Ctrl+N` (Windows) or `Cmd+N` (Mac) from anywhere
- Project creation modal opens
- Fill in details and create

---

#### Project Settings

After creating a project, you can configure settings:

1. **Open your project**
2. Click the **⚙️ Settings** icon (top right of project page)
3. **Settings available:**

**General Settings:**
- **Project Name:** Change the project name
- **Description:** Update project description
- **Archive Project:** Move to archives when done
- **Delete Project:** Permanently delete (⚠️ cannot be undone)

**Team Settings:**
- **Add Members:** Invite people to this project
- **Member Roles:** Set permissions (Owner, Editor, Viewer)
- **Remove Members:** Remove access

**Notification Settings:**
- **Email Notifications:** Choose what emails you receive
  - All activity
  - Only @mentions
  - None
- **In-App Notifications:** Browser/desktop notifications

**Privacy Settings:**
- **Visibility:** Who can see this project?
  - Public (anyone in organization)
  - Private (only invited members)

---

#### Adding Tasks to a Project

**What Is a Task?**
Tasks are individual to-dos within a project. They can be assigned to team members, have due dates, and include details and attachments.

**To Add a Task:**

1. **Open your project**
2. Find the "Tasks" section (usually in the main area)
3. Click **[+ Add Task]** or the **+** icon

4. **Enter task details:**
   - **Task Name:** (Required) What needs to be done?
     - Example: "Write blog post outline"
   
   - **Assignee:** (Optional) Who will do this?
     - Click the assignee field
     - Select a team member or type to search
     - Can assign to yourself or leave unassigned
   
   - **Due Date:** (Optional) When should this be done?
     - Click calendar icon
     - Select date
     - Today, tomorrow, and this week are quick options
   
   - **Priority:** (Optional)
     - High (🔴), Medium (🟡), Low (🟢), None

   - **Description:** (Optional) Click the task to add details
     - Add context, requirements, links
     - Use markdown formatting

5. Press **Enter** to save

**Task Actions:**
- **✅ Mark Complete:** Click the checkbox to the left
- **Edit:** Click the task name to edit
- **Delete:** Click **⋮** (three dots) → Delete
- **Duplicate:** Click **⋮** → Duplicate
- **Move:** Drag and drop to reorder or move to another section

---

#### Inviting Team Members

**To Add Someone to Your Project:**

1. **Open the project**
2. Click **[+ Add Member]** or the team icon (👥) in the toolbar
3. **Invite modal opens:**

4. **Enter email addresses:**
   - Type one or more email addresses
   - Separate with commas or press Enter between each
   - Example: sarah@company.com, john@company.com

5. **Select their role:**
   - **Owner:** Full control (edit, delete, manage members)
   - **Editor:** Can edit content, create tasks, comment
   - **Viewer:** Read-only access (can view but not edit)

6. **Add a message (optional):**
   - Personal note to include in invitation email
   - Example: "Hey! I'm adding you to our Q1 campaign project. Looking forward to working together!"

7. Click **[Send Invitations]**

**What Happens Next:**
- Invitees receive an email with a link to the project
- If they don't have an account, they'll be prompted to create one
- They'll have immediate access based on the role you assigned

---

### Feature 2: [Managing Tasks and To-Dos]

#### Task Views

**List View** (Default)
- See all tasks in a simple list
- Check off tasks as you complete them
- Great for simple workflows

**Board View** (Kanban)
1. Click **[View]** in the toolbar
2. Select **Board**
3. Tasks organized in columns: To Do, In Progress, Done
4. Drag tasks between columns to update status

**Calendar View**
1. Click **[View]** → **Calendar**
2. See tasks by due date
3. Drag to reschedule

**Timeline View** (Gantt Chart)
1. Click **[View]** → **Timeline**
2. See project schedule with task dependencies
3. Great for complex projects with multiple phases

---

#### Task Details

**To View Task Details:**
- Click on any task name
- Task detail panel opens on the right (or full screen on mobile)

**Task Detail Panel Includes:**

**1. Task Information**
- Task name (editable)
- Assignee
- Due date
- Priority
- Status
- Created by and date

**2. Description**
- Rich text editor
- Add formatting: **bold**, *italic*, lists
- Add links, images
- @mention team members

**3. Subtasks**
- Break down a task into smaller steps
- Click **[+ Add Subtask]**
- Each subtask has its own checkbox

**4. Attachments**
- Drag and drop files
- Or click **[Attach File]**
- Supported formats: PDF, images, videos, docs
- Max file size: 100MB per file

**5. Comments**
- Team discussion about this task
- @mention someone to notify them
- Edit or delete your comments

**6. Activity Log**
- See who did what and when
- Task created, edited, completed
- Comments, file uploads, etc.

---

Speed up your workflow with these shortcuts:

| Action | Windows | Mac |

| **Set due date** | `Alt+D` | `Option+D` |
| **Open task details** | `Click` or `Enter` | `Click` or `Enter` |

> **💡 Tip:** See all shortcuts by pressing `Shift+?` from anywhere

### Feature 3: [Collaboration and Communication]

#### Comments

**Adding a Comment:**
1. Open a task or project
2. Scroll to the "Comments" section
3. Type your comment in the text box
4. Click **[Comment]** or press `Ctrl+Enter`

**@Mentions:**
- Type `@` followed by a name to mention someone
- Example: "@Sarah can you review this?"
- They'll receive a notification

**Replying to Comments:**
- Hover over a comment
- Click **[Reply]**
- Your reply appears threaded below the original

**Editing/Deleting Comments:**
- Hover over your comment
- Click **⋮** (three dots)
- Select **Edit** or **Delete**

---

#### File Sharing

**Uploading Files:**

**Method 1: Drag and Drop**
1. Open task or project
2. Drag file from your computer
3. Drop it into the task detail panel or designated upload area

**Method 2: Upload Button**
1. Click **[Attach File]** or **📎** icon
2. Browse and select file(s)
3. Click **Open**

**Viewing Files:**
- Attached files appear in the "Attachments" section
- Click filename to preview (if supported) or download
- Supported previews: Images, PDFs, text files

**Organizing Files:**
- Files are automatically organized by task
- See all project files in **Files** tab (project-level view)
- Filter by file type, upload date, uploader

## Advanced Features

### Advanced Feature 1: [Automation and Workflows]

#### What Are Automations?

Automations help you save time by automatically performing actions when certain conditions are met.

**Example Automations:**
- When a task is marked complete → move it to "Done" column
- When due date approaches → send reminder email
- When someone is assigned → notify them via Slack

---

#### Creating an Automation

**Prerequisites:** 
- Owner or Admin role
- Available on Pro plan and above

**Steps:**

1. **Open Project Settings**
   - Click ⚙️ Settings
   - Select **Automations** tab

2. **Click [+ Create Automation]**

3. **Choose a Trigger** (When should this run?)
   - Task created
   - Task completed
   - Task assigned
   - Due date approaching
   - Status changed
   - Custom field updated

4. **Set Conditions** (Optional - add filters)
   - Example: "Only if task priority is High"
   - Example: "Only if assigned to Marketing team"

5. **Choose Actions** (What should happen?)
   - Send notification (email, Slack, in-app)
   - Change task status
   - Assign to someone
   - Add to another project
   - Update custom field

6. **Name Your Automation**
   - Give it a descriptive name
   - Example: "Notify team when high-priority task created"

7. **Click [Create]**

**Your automation is now active!**

---

#### Managing Automations

**View All Automations:**
- Settings > Automations
- See list of all active automations

**Edit:**
- Click automation name
- Modify trigger, conditions, or actions
- Click [Save Changes]

**Disable Temporarily:**
- Toggle switch to Off
- Automation won't run but settings are saved

**Delete:**
- Click **⋮** → Delete
- Confirm deletion

---

### Advanced Feature 2: [Custom Fields and Templates]

#### Custom Fields

Add your own fields to tasks to track information specific to your workflow.

**Available Field Types:**
- **Text:** Short text input
- **Number:** Numerical values
- **Dropdown:** Select from predefined options
- **Date:** Date picker
- **Checkbox:** Yes/no or on/off
- **Person:** Assign to team member

**Creating a Custom Field:**

1. **Project Settings** > **Custom Fields**
2. Click **[+ Add Field]**
3. **Configure:**
   - **Field Name:** What to call it (e.g., "Client Name")
   - **Field Type:** Select from list
   - **Options:** (For dropdowns) Add options
   - **Required:** Make it mandatory?
4. Click **[Add Field]**

**Using Custom Fields:**
- Custom fields appear on all tasks in that project
- Fill them in just like standard fields

## Settings and Configuration

### Account Settings

**Accessing Settings:**
- Click your **profile avatar** (top right)

- Or go to Settings in main navigation

---

#### Profile Settings

**Personal Information:**
- **Name:** Your display name
- **Email:** Your login email (cannot be changed by default)
- **Job Title:** Your role
- **Profile Photo:** Upload an image (recommended 200x200px minimum)
- **Bio:** Short description about you (optional)

**How to Update:**
1. Go to **Settings** > **Profile**
2. Click **[Edit]**
3. Make changes
4. Click **[Save Changes]**

---

#### Notification Preferences

**Email Notifications:**
Choose what emails you receive:
- **All activity:** Every comment, task assignment, etc.
- **Only @mentions and assignments:** When someone @mentions you or assigns you
- **Daily digest:** One summary email per day
- **None:** No emails (not recommended)

**In-App Notifications:**
- **Browser notifications:** Desktop popups
- **Sound:** Play sound for notifications

**How to Configure:**
1. **Settings** > **Notifications**
2. Check/uncheck preferences

#### Privacy and Security

**Password:**

**Two-Factor Authentication (2FA):**
1. **Settings** > **Security** > **Two-Factor Authentication**
2. Click **[Enable]**

4. Enter verification code
5. Save backup codes in safe place

**Active Sessions:**
- See where you're logged in
- **Settings** > **Security** > **Active Sessions**
- Click **[Sign Out]** on any session to revoke access

## Tips and Best Practices

### Organizing Projects

**✅ Do:**
- **Use descriptive names:** "Q1 Marketing Campaign" not "Project1"
- **Set due dates:** Helps prioritize and track progress
- **Break down large projects:** Use tasks and subtasks
- **Archive completed projects:** Keep dashboard clean

**❌ Don't:**
- **Create too many projects:** Group related work together
- **Let tasks pile up:** Regularly review and update
- **Forget to invite team:** Collaboration is key

---

### Task Management Tips

**Priority System:**
- 🔴 **High:** Urgent, important, blocking others
- 🟡 **Medium:** Important but not urgent
- 🟢 **Low:** Nice to have, can wait

**Due Dates:**
- Set realistic deadlines
- Build in buffer time
- Use reminders (set 1-2 days before due)

**Descriptions:**
- Add context: Why is this task important?
- Link to resources: Related docs, designs, tickets
- Define "done": What does complete look like?

---

### Collaboration Best Practices

**Communication:**
- **@mention specific people** when you need their input
- **Reply to comments** to keep conversations organized
- **Use task comments** instead of separate emails

**File Management:**
- **Name files clearly:** "Homepage_Design_v3.pdf" not "Final.pdf"
- **Version control:** Include version numbers or dates
- **Delete outdated files:** Keep only current versions

**Team Etiquette:**
- **Update task status** when you start working
- **Mark tasks complete** promptly
- **Notify team of blockers** ASAP

---

## Troubleshooting

### Common Issues and Solutions

#### I Can't Log In

**Possible Solutions:**

**1. Check your credentials**
- Email address correct? (no extra spaces)
- Password correct? (check Caps Lock)

**2. Reset your password**
- Click "Forgot Password?"
- Follow email instructions

**3. Account locked?**
- Too many failed attempts locks account for 30 minutes
- Wait or contact support

**4. Browser issues**
- Clear cache and cookies
- Try incognito/private mode
- Try different browser

**5. Still stuck?**
- Contact support: support@productname.com

---

#### Tasks Not Saving

**Possible Causes:**

**1. Connection issue**
- Check internet connection
- Refresh page and try again

**2. Browser extension conflict**
- Disable ad blockers temporarily
- Try incognito mode

**3. Unsupported characters**
- Avoid special characters in task names
- Use standard punctuation

---

#### Notifications Not Working

**Troubleshooting Steps:**

**1. Check notification settings**
- Settings > Notifications
- Ensure preferences are enabled

**2. Email notifications**
- Check spam folder
- Add support@productname.com to contacts
- Verify email address in profile

**3. Browser notifications**
- Allow notifications in browser settings
- Check OS notification permissions

**4. Slack/integrations**
- Verify integration is connected
- Check channel settings
- Re-authorize if needed

## FAQs

**Q: Is there a mobile app?**
A: Yes! Download for iOS and Android. Search "[Product Name]" in App Store or Google Play.

**Q: How many projects can I create?**
A: Unlimited on all plans.

**Q: Can I use this offline?**
A: Limited functionality. You can view cached projects/tasks but need internet to sync changes.

**Q: What file types can I upload?**
A: Most common types: PDF, DOC, XLS, images (JPG, PNG, GIF), videos (MP4). Max 100MB per file.

**Q: How do I delete my account?**
A: Settings > Account > Delete Account. ⚠️ This is permanent and cannot be undone.

**Q: Is my data secure?**
A: Yes. We use bank-level encryption, SOC 2 certified data centers, and never sell your data. See our [Privacy Policy].

**Q: Can I export my data?**
A: Yes! Settings > Account > Export Data. Receives zip file with all your content.

**Q: What's the difference between Archive and Delete?**
A: **Archive** hides the project but keeps it recoverable. **Delete** permanently removes it.

## Glossary

**Term** | **Definition**
---------|---------------
**Project** | A workspace for organizing related tasks and collaborating with your team
**Task** | An individual to-do item within a project
**Assignee** | The person responsible for completing a task
**Due Date** | The deadline for completing a task or project
**@Mention** | Tagging someone in a comment to notify them (e.g., @Sarah)
**Automation** | A rule that automatically performs actions based on triggers
**Custom Field** | A user-defined data field added to tasks
**Integration** | Connection between [Product Name] and another tool
